meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 把解析后的结构化文档和你的查询意图转成四色卡片：事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，每张附来源片段，保证可溯源。
howto.when: 当你已有解析后的结构化文档和明确查询意图，需要产出可审计卡片时触发；也可由通政司 Worker 主调用，或运行 run_four_color_cards.py 的 extract、review、propose 等阶段。

say.text: 根据这份文档和我的调研意图，生成四色卡片。
say.note: 产出蓝、绿、黄、红四张卡并附来源。

say.text: 先跑 extract 阶段，抽取事实蓝卡。
say.note: 只执行事实抽取这一步。

say.text: 帮我看看黄卡里有没有过度声明。
say.note: 黄卡按过度声明规则复核。

howto.what_en: Turns parsed structured documents plus your intent into four cards: blue (facts), green (explanations), yellow (risks), red (actions). Each card carries source snippets and a traceable generation method.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have a parsed document plus a clear intent and want auditable cards, or call run_four_color_cards.py with stage extract, review or propose.

say_en.text: Generate four-color cards from this document and my research intent.
say_en.note: Produces blue, green, yellow and red cards with sources.

say_en.text: Run the extract stage to pull the fact blue card first.
Check the yellow card for overclaims.
say_en.note: Risk card is reviewed for overclaims.
